summary: Validated deployment-readiness regression scope after frontend api.ts fail-fast change. Frontend build and runtime login/dashboard flows are working on preview URL; backend core auth/health smoke checks pass.

minor.issue: Auth playbook file referenced by instructions is missing in workspace; auth checks executed via API and credentials file instead.
Uses fallback defaults for DJANGO_SECRET_KEY and DATABASE_URL; this is not fail-fast and can hide misconfiguration in non-prod environments.

action_items: No regression found from api.ts fail-fast change for this scope.
Optional hardening: remove SECRET_KEY and DATABASE_URL defaults in Django settings to enforce strict env fail-fast behavior.
If process documentation requires it, add/restore /app/auth_testing.md.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend api.ts fail-fast behavior is correctly implemented (`if (!BASE) throw new Error(...)`) and does not break build/runtime when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set.
No mocked frontend/backend API layer was introduced in tested source paths (grep scan for mock/stub patterns returned no runtime mocking implementation).
Core authenticated data flow remains intact: login -> token/cookie set -> /api/auth/me and dashboard API load.
seed_data_creation: No persistent business seed data created. Temporary lockout username and temporary owner password mutation were used, then restored via seed_admin validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 focuses on deployment-readiness after frontend env fail-fast change. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_deployment_readiness.py for quick auth/health smoke in future regressions.
rca of the issue: No runtime/build regression caused by the frontend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fail-fast patch. Prior deployment failure context remains architectural PostgreSQL-vs-Mongo platform incompatibility, not a frontend runtime defect.
